[[File:Festival of the Four Winds logo.png|400px|right]] [[Festival of the Four Winds]] is an annual summer themed [[festival]]. It features the combination of most festival content from [[Bazaar of the Four Winds]], launched on [[Game updates/2013-07-09|July 9, 2013]], and [[Queen's Jubilee]], launched on [[Game updates/2013-08-06|August 6, 2013]]. The first Festival of the Four Winds event was launched on [[Game updates/2014-05-20|May 20, 2014]] as a celebration for the Chinese release and as a prequel to [[Living World Season 2]]. It has returned as an annual event starting with its July 23rd, 2018 release. During the festival, [[Labyrinthine Cliffs]] and [[The Crown Pavilion (zone)|The Crown Pavilion]] are open to visitors from all of [[Tyria]]. == Releases == * [[Bazaar of the Four Winds]] (2013-07-09 — 2013-07-23) * [[Queen's Jubilee]] (2013-08-06 — 2013-08-20) * [[Festival of the Four Winds 2014]] (2014-05-20 — 2014-07-01) * [[Festival of the Four Winds 2018]] (2018-07-24 — 2018-08-14) * [[Festival of the Four Winds 2019]] (2019-07-30 — 2019-08-20) * [[Festival of the Four Winds 2020]] (2020-08-11 — 2020-09-01) * [[Festival of the Four Winds 2021]] (2021-08-31 — 2021-09-21) * [[Festival of the Four Winds 2022]] (2022-08-02 — 2022-08-23) * [[Festival of the Four Winds 2023]] (2023-07-18 — 2023-08-08) * [[Festival of the Four Winds 2024]] (2024-07-30 — 2024-08-20) * [[Festival of the Four Winds 2025]] (2025-08-05 — 2025-08-26) * [[Festival of the Four Winds 2026]] (2026-08-11 — 2026-09-01) == Activities == === Zones === {| {{STDT|location sortable}} style="max-width:134em;" |- ! class="unsortable" | Loading screen !!
